---
title: "Exercise 5 · Your Own Workflow"
subtitle: "Assemble everything into a prototype for a real research task"
---

::: {.callout-note appearance="minimal"}
**Time:** ~30 min · **Pairs with:** [Build Session](../build-session.qmd) · **Goal:** a working prototype workflow for one of your own research tasks, and a clear next step.
:::

This is the capstone. You'll combine the repo, `CLAUDE.md`, a skill, and the git review loop around **one real task** from your work. Full guidance — checkpoints, path, and the "done" definition — lives on the [Build Session](../build-session.qmd) page. This page is your quick checklist.

## The four moves

1. **Scaffold a repo** for a real task (`git init`; have the agent set up a reproducible structure; first commit).
2. **Write a `CLAUDE.md`** ([Ex 3](ex3-claude-md.qmd)) so the agent understands the project.
3. **Ship one change** through **branch → PR → review → merge** ([Ex 2](ex2-git-with-agent.qmd)).
4. **Write one skill** ([Ex 4](ex4-first-skill.qmd)) for the repeatable part, committed into the repo.

## Checkpoints

| Time | You should have… |
|------|------------------|
| +5 min | A git repo with a scaffolded structure and a first commit |
| +10 min | A `CLAUDE.md` with project context and guardrails |
| +20 min | One change shipped through a pull request you reviewed |
| +30 min | One skill written and committed |

## You're done when… (the take-home checklist)

- [ ] A repo for a real task, ideally pushed to GitHub.
- [ ] A `CLAUDE.md` the agent reads each session.
- [ ] At least one change shipped through **branch → PR → review → merge**.
- [ ] At least one **skill** capturing something you'll do again.
- [ ] A written **next step** (put it at the bottom of your `CLAUDE.md` under `## TODO`).

::: {.callout-tip}
## Capture your next step in the repo
End by asking the agent:
```text
Add a "## Next steps" section to the README listing the 3 things I
should do next to develop this workflow further. Commit it.
```
Now your momentum is saved in the repo, not just your head.
:::

## Share out (last 5 min)

Post one of these in the Zoom chat:

- The **skill** you wrote (its `description` line), or
- The **task** you scaffolded and what surprised you, or
- One thing you'll **change about how you work** starting Monday.
